prompts.intent: generate full blank using actual project icon
prompts.prompt:
Use case: product-mockup. Create a very high quality sculptural coin blank DESIGN REFERENCE SHEET, not a poster, not vector artwork. Input reference: the provided blue open-book application icon is the actual The Second Language project identity. Use ONLY its recognisable open double-page outline, central spine and three incised horizontal lines per page as the basis for a shallow metal relief on the REVERSE. Remove the rectangular app background and do not use blue.

One manufactured object, two faces: a pristine circular collectible coin blank, nominal diameter 40mm, field-to-field body thickness 2.8mm, narrow raised lip 0.65mm wide and 0.20mm above each face. Rounded shoulders. The side has 120 subtle round-bottom axial reeds, shallow fine cuts, never gear teeth. Compact credible thin coin proportions. No stacking of decorative concentric rings.

OBVERSE: entirely vacant clean planar field. Absolutely no central motif, logo, lettering, numerals, watermark, ornament, scratches pretending to be designs, or hole. Only the necessary narrow manufacturing rim.
REVERSE: elegant subordinate series identity, a modest centred shallow sculpted open-book emblem (about 42% of coin diameter), clean precise relief and incised lines with honest thickness and shadows, smooth surrounding negative space, small refined serif uppercase legend on upper arc EXACTLY "THE SECOND LANGUAGE". Along lower arc exactly "XXX · XXX". No actual chapter number, year, "FOUNDATION", F-001, dates or edition symbol. Every variable inscription uses uppercase XXX only. Static series name remains real. Low relief, not a thick separate glued badge. No wreath, crown, border beads, stars, filigree, secondary story picture. The physical reverse core is planar with low relief.

Render entirely neutral grey clay across the SAME coin geometry, matte nonmetal sculptural study under broad restrained studio lights; no colour, emissive light, smoke or particles. Smooth but not inflated, sharp purposeful engraved edges, no artificial AI texture, no painterly noise. Quiet mid-grey background with complete silhouette and room around all views.

Composition: beautifully clear FOUR PANEL sheet, 2 columns x 2 rows: upper left exact straight-on obverse (blank), upper right exact straight-on reverse (book and exact text); lower left three-quarter obverse showing the real thin reeded edge, lower right three-quarter reverse showing shallow relief and thin edge. Same scale and object in each panel, no overlap, complete coins. No captions, no dimension arrows, no page title, no extra text except permitted inscriptions on reverse. High resolution detailed 3D product-design render. The purpose is to choose an artistically credible common base and reverse, keeping the future theme entirely absent.

prompts.intent: reduce reverse emblem and lettering in full object
prompts.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit this FOUR PANEL clay design sheet with exactly one design change: reduce the central reverse open-book relief to about 74% of its current width and height (about 42% of the coin diameter), preserving its centre, shape, central spine and three engraved lines per page. Reduce the size of the reverse lettering to about 75% of current letter height, keeping the upper legend EXACTLY "THE SECOND LANGUAGE" on a restrained upper arc and lower legend EXACTLY "XXX · XXX" on a restrained lower arc. Wider quiet negative space gives a finely manufactured collectible medal rather than an enlarged app badge. All future variable identity fields remain XXX placeholders. Do NOT put text or any emblem on either obverse view. Keep the same four camera views, the thin body, subtle rounded edge reeding, narrow manufacturing lip, matte nonmetal neutral-grey clay, balanced soft studio lighting, background, image framing. No added decorative rings, no border beads, no filigree, no colour, no smoke, no particles. Preserve the controlled elegant coined shallow relief with clear bevels and clean incisions. This is a complete object design sheet; the two blank obverse panels must remain completely empty.

Use case: product-mockup. Use the referenced refined four-view clay coin sheet as the exact complete object design. Create a supplementary EIGHT VIEW geometry design reference sheet of the SAME collectible coin blank. Preserve every physical detail: circular 40mm nominal diameter, slender 2.8mm field-to-field thickness, narrow raised manufacturing lip, rounded shoulders, fine shallow axial reeding (not teeth), completely blank planar obverse, reverse modest open-book shallow relief with two pages and three incised lines each. Reverse lettering is exactly "THE SECOND LANGUAGE" above and exactly "XXX · XXX" below. No other words or numbers on the coin. Match reduced emblem scale and quiet spacing in reference.
Render neutral matte GREY CLAY, nonmetal, broad fixed soft lights, calm grey studio background. No colour, shine, smoke or particles, absolutely no theme drawing.

Arrange a high resolution 4 columns x 2 rows sheet with eight clearly separated complete objects, no captions or page text. First row left-to-right: (1) obverse seen from FRONT LEFT about45degrees, blank face and thin edge; (2) reverse seen from BACK LEFT about45degrees, correct normal readable reverse text; (3) obverse from ABOVE at35degrees, blank face and top shoulder; (4) reverse from ABOVE at35degrees, readable reverse and top shoulder. Second row left-to-right: (5) exact LEFT side/profile, edge-only thin vertical strip with round shoulders, not a wide ellipse; (6) exact RIGHT side/profile, edge-only thin vertical strip; (7) exact TOP edge-only view, thin horizontal strip showing axial reeding; (8) exact BOTTOM edge-only view, matching thin horizontal strip. Display profiles at same diameter scale as three-quarter coins; side/top strips legitimately reveal the thin body. No perspective swelling. No stands, hands, packaging, diagrams, decorative overlays. Make a meticulous clean manufacturing concept sheet, crisp and intentional, all faces belong to a single coherent object. Static background must not become a scene or environment.

prompts.intent: material study without changing full design
prompts.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer, product-mockup. Change ONLY the material and studio reflection finish of the provided complete four-view neutral clay coin sheet. Preserve the exact coin geometry, proportions, cameras, composition and all inscription positions. OBVERSE remains completely blank: no text, no logo, no pattern, no figure. REVERSE keeps the same modest shallow open-book emblem derived from project icon, three incised lines each page and central spine. The upper inscription is EXACTLY "THE SECOND LANGUAGE"; the lower inscription is EXACTLY "XXX · XXX". No other characters, actual dates, chapter codes or edition marks.

Make this an exceptionally refined real manufactured collectible silver medal material study: gently warm neutral silver metal, very fine satin field on both sides, subtle authentic directional microfinish visible only near highlights; slightly more polished narrow rim and shoulders, polished high edges of shallow book relief and lettering, fine round-bottom axial reeding with crisp silver reflections. Physically believable anisotropy and restrained studio softbox reflections that turn with the face normal. Neither mirror chrome nor painted grey plastic, no dirty patina, no copper rust, no gold added, no grain/noise spread evenly as decoration. Clean hand-finished object, purposeful surface hierarchy. Background is quiet dark warm-grey and lights are broad real studio panels so shiny silver reads clearly without burning out or swallowing inscriptions.

Keep the FOUR panel 2x2 layout: straight-on empty obverse; straight-on reverse; three-quarter empty obverse; three-quarter reverse. Entire coin in every panel, same scale. No captions, no extra props, no pedestal or packaging. No emissive light, no particles, no fog. This is the SAME base object with material, not a newly redesigned coin.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Keep this exact four-panel coin reference image, object, framing, text, icon, and geometry. Correct ONLY the surface finish of the metal: remove all visible wavy hammered texture, orange-peel grain, crinkles and random embossed surface noise from both blank fields and the shallow book emblem. The obverse is a perfectly clean, genuinely planar empty minted field, showing a continuous softly graded silver reflection, not a foil sheet or brushed painted plastic. Subtle ultra-fine satin microsurface may remain but must be almost imperceptible at this scale, no discernible pattern. Polish only the narrow rim/shoulder and tiny relief bevels. Gentle neutral silver, with restrained smooth softbox reflections and credible metal roughness; not chrome or mirror-black. Retain the clear shallow actual depth and crisp three incised page lines. Reverse lettering EXACTLY "THE SECOND LANGUAGE" and "XXX · XXX". Same 2x2 views, completely empty obverse, quiet grey background. No actual dates/numbers, no new ornament, no colour glow, no smoke/particles, no changes in silhouette.

prompts.intent: paired appearance using two complete object references
prompts.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Image 1 is the eight-view grey clay geometry sheet and is the EDIT TARGET. Image 2 is the refined four-view neutral silver finish sheet and is ONLY the material/reference appearance. Apply Image2's refined neutral silver metal finish to every view in Image1. Preserve exactly Image1's eight-view arrangement, camera angles, complete silhouettes, thin coin body, narrow lip, exact same book emblem relief and same literal inscriptions "THE SECOND LANGUAGE" and "XXX · XXX". Completely blank obverse in every front view. Do not add new text or actual dates, codes, edition marks.
Clean smooth ultra-fine satin fields with continuous physically believable silver light gradients, very little visible grain, polished narrow shoulder and relief bevels, crisp fine round-bottom axial edge reeds. No wrinkled/hammered foil, no noisy AI texture, no chrome-black or painted plastic. Broad restrained studio reflectors, quiet slightly darker neutral-grey background.
The first row MUST keep (1) front-left blank obverse, (2) back-left book reverse, (3) upper-front blank obverse, (4) upper-back book reverse. Second row keep left profile, right profile, top edge, bottom edge. Thin profile strips stay thin, not oval front views. Preserve physically upright normal readable text on reverse views. No captions, stand, packaging, aura or particles/fog. The result is a matching material companion to the exact complete-object clay reference sheet.

prompts.intent: structure details with full object locator
prompts.prompt:
Use case: product-mockup. This is a detail companion to the referenced COMPLETE coin blank design sheet, not a new design. Create a four-panel neutral GREY CLAY macro study of the same exact object, keeping a small clear full-coin reverse locator thumbnail inside each panel so each detail stays visibly tied to the complete coin. Locator reverse carries the same modest open-book and exact inscriptions "THE SECOND LANGUAGE" and "XXX · XXX". No new text/captions/dimension numbers outside the object.
Four clearly separated panels: 1, close oblique look at the upper narrow raised lip transitioning to the totally empty flat obverse and fine reeded shoulder. 2, macro oblique of the cylindrical shallow axial round-bottom edge grooves and smooth upper/lower shoulders, believable thin 2.8mm core rather than deep gear teeth. 3, macro reverse central open-book shallow relief with two pages and central seam, exactly three incised rounded-ended line grooves per page; small bevels and honest low height flowing from the underlying planar coin, not a sticker. 4, macro reverse lower inscription EXACTLY "XXX · XXX", crisp shallow serif embossing, rim context at lower edge.
Controlled very smooth clay, no surface noise, no colour or metal, no fog or particles, broad gentle studio light showing real form. Background quiet grey, no ornament, no dates/codes, no scratches or damage. Preserve reduced book size and negative space in the locator. The macros are derived shape-design studies with a complete-object context, carefully rendered and purposeful.
